The competitor's new loyalty program poses a significant threat to our business. By integrating discounts, rewards, and personalized experiences directly into their mobile app, they are creating a high barrier to switching for their customers. This strategy is likely to increase their customer retention rates while actively eroding our market share. To mitigate this impact, we must urgently evaluate our own customer engagement strategies, potentially by enhancing our digital presence, introducing competitive rewards, or improving personalization efforts to retain our existing customer base.
